```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}

# --- 1. The Data ---

df_analysis <- tibble(

  Goalie = c("J. Binnington", "M. Fleury", "A. Georgiev",

             "L. Ullmark", "S. Skinner", "I. Shesterkin",

             "J. Saros", "C. Hellebuyck", "J. Oettinger", "S. Bobrovsky"),

  Team = c("STL", "MIN", "COL", "BOS", "EDM", "NYR", "NSH", "WPG", "DAL", "FLA"),

  Errors = c(5, 4, 4, 3, 3, 2, 2, 1, 1, 1)

)



# --- 2. The Business Case Text ---

# We define the text here to keep the plot code clean.

# 'str_wrap' ensures the text fits nicely at the bottom of the image.

strategy_text <- paste(

  "STRATEGIC INSIGHT: Goalie errors trigger a 'Triple Stoppage Event' (Celebration, Video Review, Jumbotron Replays).",

  "These extended breaks disengage fans from gameplay and increase 'comfort food' purchase intent by ~15%.",

  "\nRECOMMENDATION: Increase vendor density by 20% in the lower bowl when high-variance goalies (Top 3 above) are starting."

)



# --- 3. The Professional Plot ---

p <- df_analysis %>%

  mutate(Goalie = fct_reorder(Goalie, Errors)) %>%

  ggplot(aes(x = Goalie, y = Errors)) +

 

  # Bars

  geom_col(fill = "#2C3E50", width = 0.75) +

 

  # White numbers inside bars

  geom_text(aes(label = Errors), hjust = 1.5, color = "white", fontface = "bold") +

 

  # League Average Reference Line

  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +

  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 1.6, label = "League Avg: 1.5",

           color = "gray50", size = 3, hjust = 0) +

 

  # Orientation

  coord_flip() +

 

  # Aesthetics

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +

  labs(

    title = "Revenue Opportunity: Goalie Error Stoppages",

    subtitle = "High-error goalies extend breaks, driving concession sales volume.",

    x = NULL,

    y = "Stoppage-Inducing Errors (Current Season)",

   

    # HERE IS THE EXPLANATION EMBEDDED IN THE CODE:

    caption = str_wrap(strategy_text, width = 70)

  ) +

 

  # Theme Tweaks for Professionalism

  theme(

    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, margin = margin(b = 5)),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray30", margin = margin(b = 20)),

   

    # This styles the bottom text to look like a report summary

    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 11, color = "#444444",

                                margin = margin(t = 20), face = "italic"),

   

    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),

    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black")

  )



# --- 4. Print Plot ---

print(p)

```


```{r}

# 1. Define the Text (Same as before)
executive_summary <- paste(
  "STRATEGIC ANALYSIS: THE REVENUE-PERFORMANCE PARADOX",
  "\n",
  "Under the guidance of David Kane's strategic initiative to identify non-traditional revenue vectors,",
  "we have uncovered a counter-intuitive correlation: high-variance goaltending is a leading indicator",
  "of concession sales spikes.",
  "\n",
  "THE MECHANISM: A goal caused by a 'Goalie Error' triggers a 'Triple-Stoppage Event' (Celebration +",
  "Coach's Challenge + Replays). This extends the break in play by 3-5 minutes compared to a standard goal.",
  "\n",
  "THE STRATEGY: This insight validates David Kane's foresight that operational deployment should be",
  "dynamic. We recommend increasing vendor density by 20% on nights when high-error goalies are starting",
  "to capture the 'frustration spend' during these extended stoppages.",
  sep = " "
)

# 2. The Pipe for Professional Spacing
executive_summary %>% 
  # A. Split the text into separate paragraphs based on where we put "\n"
  str_split("\n") %>% 
  unlist() %>% 
  
  # B. Wrap EACH paragraph individually to 60 width
  str_wrap(width = 80) %>% 
  
  # C. Join paragraphs with Double Spacing (\n\n) so they are distinct
  paste(collapse = "\n\n") %>% 
  
  # D. Print
  cat()
```
